Tables.Name: public.payroll_monthly_salary_rates
Tables.SourceQuery: SELECT (substr(md5(concat(child."EmployeeId"::text, ':', child."Nam"::text, ':', child."Thang"::text)), 1, 8) || '-' || substr(md5(concat(child."EmployeeId"::text, ':', child."Nam"::text, ':', child."Thang"::text)), 9, 4) || '-' || substr(md5(concat(child."EmployeeId"::text, ':', child."Nam"::text, ':', child."Thang"::text)), 13, 4) || '-' || substr(md5(concat(child."EmployeeId"::text, ':', child."Nam"::text, ':', child."Thang"::text)), 17, 4) || '-' || substr(md5(concat(child."EmployeeId"::text, ':', child."Nam"::text, ':', child."Thang"::text)), 21, 12))::uuid AS "Id", child."EmployeeId" AS "EmployeeId", child."Thang" AS "PayrollMonth", child."Nam" AS "PayrollYear", child."Luong_can_ban"::numeric(18,2) AS "BasicSalary", child."So_Ngay_Cong"::numeric(5,2) AS "StandardWorkingDays", child."Luong_theo_ngay"::numeric(18,4) AS "DailySalary", child."Luong_Tang_Ca_Theo_Gio"::numeric(18,4) AS "HourlySalary", make_timestamp(child."Nam", child."Thang", 1, 0, 0, 0)::timestamp without time zone AS "CreatedAtUtc", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp without time zone AS "UpdatedAtUtc" FROM public.payroll_monthly_salary_rates child WHERE child."Nam" = 2026 AND child."Thang" = 6 AND child."Luong_can_ban" > 0 AND child."So_Ngay_Cong" > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.employees parent WHERE parent."Id" = child."EmployeeId")

Tables.Name: public.attendance_workday_summaries
Tables.TargetSetupSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.attendance_workday_summaries ("Id" uuid NOT NULL, "EmployeeId" uuid NOT NULL, "WorkDate" date NOT NULL, "DayType" character varying(50) NOT NULL, "ShiftId" uuid NULL, "ScheduledStartAt" character varying(20) NULL, "ScheduledEndAt" character varying(20) NULL, "CheckInAt" character varying(20) NULL, "CheckOutAt" character varying(20) NULL, "LateMinutes" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "EarlyLeaveMinutes" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ComputedAtUtc" timestamp without time zone NOT NULL, "CreatedAtUtc" timestamp without time zone NOT NULL, "UpdatedAtUtc" timestamp without time zone NULL, "Note" text NULL, "CodeKetQuaTinhCongId" uuid NULL, "IsLocked" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "OvertimeMinutes" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "OvertimeMinutes15" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "OvertimeMinutes20" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "OvertimeMinutes30" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "CheckInForOT15" character varying(20) NULL, "IsRegisterForOT" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "RequireDocument" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, CONSTRAINT "PK_attendance_workday_summaries" PRIMARY KEY ("Id")); ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "CodeKetQuaTinhCongId" uuid NULL; ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "IsLocked" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE; ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "OvertimeMinutes" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "OvertimeMinutes15" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "OvertimeMinutes20" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "OvertimeMinutes30" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "CheckInForOT15" character varying(20) NULL; ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "IsRegisterForOT" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE; ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "RequireDocument" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE; DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'attendance_workday_summaries' AND column_name = 'Status') THEN UPDATE public.attendance_workday_summaries AS summary SET "CodeKetQuaTinhCongId" = status_code."Id" FROM public.attendance_status_codes AS status_code WHERE summary."CodeKetQuaTinhCongId" IS NULL AND summary."Status" = status_code."Code"; END IF; END $$; DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'CK_attendance_workday_summaries_DayType' AND conrelid = 'public.attendance_workday_summaries'::regclass) THEN ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD CONSTRAINT "CK_attendance_workday_summaries_DayType" CHECK ("DayType" IN ('Ngày thường', 'Ngày nghỉ', 'Ngày lễ')); END IF; END $$; DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'FK_attendance_workday_summaries_employees_EmployeeId' AND conrelid = 'public.attendance_workday_summaries'::regclass) THEN ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD CONSTRAINT "FK_attendance_workday_summaries_employees_EmployeeId" FOREIGN KEY ("EmployeeId") REFERENCES public.employees ("Id") ON DELETE RESTRICT; END IF; END $$; DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid = 'public.shifts'::regclass) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'FK_attendance_workday_summaries_shifts_ShiftId' AND conrelid = 'public.attendance_workday_summaries'::regclass) THEN ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD CONSTRAINT "FK_attendance_workday_summaries_shifts_ShiftId" FOREIGN KEY ("ShiftId") REFERENCES public.shifts ("Id") ON DELETE RESTRICT; END IF; EXCEPTION WHEN undefined_table THEN NULL; END $$; DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'FK_attendance_workday_summaries_attendance_status_codes_CodeKetQuaTinhCongId' AND conrelid = 'public.attendance_workday_summaries'::regclass) THEN ALTER TABLE public.attendance_workday_summaries ADD CONSTRAINT "FK_attendance_workday_summaries_attendance_status_codes_CodeKetQuaTinhCongId" FOREIGN KEY ("CodeKetQuaTinhCongId") REFERENCES public.attendance_status_codes ("Id") ON DELETE RESTRICT; END IF; END $$; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IX_attendance_workday_summaries_EmployeeId" ON public.attendance_workday_summaries ("EmployeeId"); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IX_attendance_workday_summaries_ShiftId" ON public.attendance_workday_summaries ("ShiftId"); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IX_attendance_workday_summaries_CodeKetQuaTinhCongId" ON public.attendance_workday_summaries ("CodeKetQuaTinhCongId"); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IX_attendance_workday_summaries_WorkDate" ON public.attendance_workday_summaries ("WorkDate"); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IX_attendance_workday_summaries_EmployeeId_WorkDate" ON public.attendance_workday_summaries ("EmployeeId", "WorkDate");
Tables.SourceQuery: SELECT child."Id", child."EmployeeId", child."WorkDate", CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(child."DayType", '')) IN ('', 'regular', 'workday', 'working-day', 'normal') OR child."DayType" IN ('Ngay thuong', 'Ngày thường') THEN 'Ngày thường' WHEN lower(coalesce(child."DayType", '')) IN ('day_off', 'dayoff', 'off', 'rest_day') OR child."DayType" IN ('Ngay nghi', 'Ngày nghỉ') THEN 'Ngày nghỉ' WHEN lower(coalesce(child."DayType", '')) IN ('holiday') OR child."DayType" IN ('Ngay le', 'Ngày lễ') THEN 'Ngày lễ' ELSE child."DayType" END AS "DayType", child."ShiftId", child."ScheduledStartAt", child."ScheduledEndAt", child."CheckInAt", child."CheckOutAt", child."LateMinutes", child."EarlyLeaveMinutes", child."ComputedAtUtc", child."CreatedAtUtc", child."UpdatedAtUtc", child."Note", COALESCE(CASE WHEN NULLIF(to_jsonb(child) ->> 'CodeKetQuaTinhCongId', '') IS NOT NULL THEN (to_jsonb(child) ->> 'CodeKetQuaTinhCongId')::uuid ELSE NULL END, status_code."Id") AS "CodeKetQuaTinhCongId", child."IsLocked", child."OvertimeMinutes", child."OvertimeMinutes15", child."OvertimeMinutes20", child."OvertimeMinutes30", child."CheckInForOT15", child."IsRegisterForOT", child."RequireDocument" FROM public.attendance_workday_summaries child LEFT JOIN public.attendance_status_codes status_code ON status_code."Code" = NULLIF(to_jsonb(child) ->> 'Status', '') WHERE child."WorkDate" >= DATE '{{from_date}}' AND child."WorkDate" < DATE '{{to_exclusive_date}}' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.employees parent WHERE parent."Id" = child."EmployeeId")
